'''Shane Butler''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Fargo tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|mind what you have learned/super falcon/on the edge]], according to Jeff Kasper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1520">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ fargo-nd-12-9-00], DeckTech (jeff "kazper" kasper, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Shane Butler (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Set 23]], dated 2024 on this wiki.
